sources.credit: Iwan Baan / Art Gallery of New South Wales
sources.observation: The open entry canopy has shallow rolled glass spans above a grid of thin white steel posts. The cylindrical welcome desk sits in the covered plaza.

sources.credit: Iwan Baan / Art Gallery of New South Wales
sources.observation: The aerial view shows the dark solar array, white stone pavilions, lower planted roofs, glass galleries and curved outdoor steps.

limitations: Wall and roof elevations, terrace planting, canopy span spacing and the arrangement of solar panels are estimated from photographs. The model represents the exterior and open entrance plaza.
